description: Generate snow_connector.py — ServiceNow inbound webhook connector for Phase 9 enterprise integration. MUST follow numbered rules: (1) MUST authenticate via SNOW OAuth 2.0 using env vars SNOW_CLIENT_ID and SNOW_CLIENT_SECRET, (2) MUST validate request signature using HMAC-SHA256, (3) MUST reject unsigned webhooks with 401 response, (4) MUST parse SNOW incident JSON for MCP server approval requests, (5) MUST query write_service at 8772 for verdict status before responding, (6) MUST never commit MCP to APPROVED without human analyst sign-off, (7) MUST log all decisions to audit_log table with timestamp column, (8) MUST run on port 8784. Pattern: if __name__ == '__main__': run()
